notes.title: New Version and please write a review if you like my game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I just pushed a new version, which allows you to see what items you have collected and how long active items will last. Sorry for not updating in a while, I was rather busy with an internship which is now over.

The first month after the release is now over and Aliens&Asteroids has sold about 400 units. Thank you everybody for supporting me. On this note I also want to ask you, if you liked the game can you please write a review and if you did not like the game please let me know why not so I can improve upon it.

Next I will probably work on enabling translation or trading cards, should they be approved for my game.

Best regards
Marc

notes.title: New version, Thank you and Beta branch
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

first of all a thank you for all of you who bought my game and supported me with bug, reports and improvement advice. Thank you.

As of today Aliens&Asteroids has sold 250 times. That number might seem rather small and not really something to be happy about, but all the reviews I received so far were positiv and therefore I believe that most of you who bought the game are indeed enjoying it. And that is certainly something to be happy about.

Next there is a new Beta branch available with the new version 0.10.0.22. It has no password or anything and is open for everyone. In the future I will always first upload a new version to the beta branch and several days later to the default branch so that all of you can enjoy it. The reason behind it is mostly to test the new versions for bugs.

In the new version the Magic potion is implemented and the crystal bug is fixed, as well as some smaller changes to some existing items.

And Thank you again for all the kind reviews. Each of them means a lot to me and I can't wait for the day when the blue thumbs up Button appears on my store page.

Best regards and have a very nice day,

Marc

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Steam Leaderboard and increased Crystal Drop Chance
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30105604/7d2d31467e5210a2041e34b4f0b96f22403c105b.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30105604/999ddb15a7bb021963ed1a7064df4174d97650f8.png[/img][/url]

Hello everybody,

I was able to fix most reported bugs (except the music/sound issue, that will take a while) and a new Version 0.10.0.20 will go live in a few minutes. 

Also I included a button to get directly to the steam Leaderboard and increased the drop chance of a crystal to 2.5% per Ufo. I am not sure if I will leave it that high, but for now it will help you to unlock all the amazing features I developed :D

Best Regards,
Marc

notes.title: Delays in Development and Marketing
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

I will have to delay the release date of Aliens&Asteroids by at least a week. The reason behind this is on the one hand that I was sick for most of the last week and on the other hand that I found several features/bugs I wanted to implement/fix before releasing the game.

Sorry for the delays
